sub_graphs.title: Prague Stack: PUSH Operations State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime state transitions when PUSH0-PUSH32 opcodes are executed, including bytecode reading and stack modification

nodes.label: PUSH Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched a PUSH0-PUSH32 opcode from bytecode at current program counter

nodes.label: Read N Immediate Bytes from Bytecode
nodes.description: Read N bytes (0-32) following the PUSH opcode from bytecode for the value to push

nodes.label: Convert Bytes to U256 Big-Endian
nodes.description: Convert the N bytes to a 256-bit unsigned integer using big-endian encoding

nodes.label: Push Value onto Stack
nodes.description: Push the converted U256 value onto the top of the EVM stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter by 1+N
nodes.description: Advance program counter by 1 (opcode) + N (immediate bytes) positions

nodes.label: PUSH Operation Complete
nodes.description: Stack has new value on top, PC advanced past opcode and immediate data

nodes.label: Charge Gas for PUSH
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BASE (for PUSH0) or GAS_VERY_LOW (for PUSH1-PUSH32) from remaining gas

sub_graphs.title: Prague Stack: POP Operation State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime state transition when POP opcode removes the top stack element

nodes.label: POP Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched the POP opcode from bytecode

nodes.label: Charge GAS_BASE for POP
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_BASE from remaining gas for POP operation

nodes.label: Remove Top Stack Element
nodes.description: Pop and discard the topmost element from the EVM stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter by 1
nodes.description: Advance program counter by 1 position past POP opcode

nodes.label: POP Operation Complete
nodes.description: Top stack element removed, PC advanced

sub_graphs.title: Prague Stack: DUP1-DUP16 Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime state transitions for DUP operations that duplicate stack elements

nodes.label: DUP Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched a DUP1-DUP16 opcode from bytecode

nodes.label: Charge GAS_VERY_LOW for DUP
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_VERY_LOW from remaining gas for DUP operation

nodes.label: Validate Stack Has N Elements
nodes.description: Check that item_number < len(evm.stack) to ensure the requested position exists

nodes.label: StackUnderflowError Raised
nodes.description: Stack depth insufficient for requested DUP position, execution halts with error

nodes.label: Copy Element at Position N to Top
nodes.description: Duplicate the stack element at position N (0-indexed from top) to the stack top

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter by 1
nodes.description: Advance program counter by 1 position past DUP opcode

nodes.label: DUP Operation Complete
nodes.description: Element duplicated to stack top, PC advanced

sub_graphs.title: Prague Stack: SWAP1-SWAP16 Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime state transitions for SWAP operations that exchange stack elements

nodes.label: SWAP Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched a SWAP1-SWAP16 opcode from bytecode

nodes.label: Charge GAS_VERY_LOW for SWAP
nodes.description: Deduct GAS_VERY_LOW from remaining gas for SWAP operation

nodes.label: Validate Stack Has N+1 Elements
nodes.description: Check that item_number < len(evm.stack) to ensure both positions exist

nodes.label: StackUnderflowError Raised
nodes.description: Stack depth insufficient for requested SWAP position, execution halts with error

nodes.label: Exchange Top with Element at Position N
nodes.description: Swap the top stack element with the element at position N

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter by 1
nodes.description: Advance program counter by 1 position past SWAP opcode

nodes.label: SWAP Operation Complete
nodes.description: Elements swapped, PC advanced

sub_graphs.title: Prague Stack: Stack Bounds Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation logic that prevents stack underflow attacks through bounds checking

nodes.label: Stack Operation Requested
nodes.description: A DUP or SWAP operation has been requested with a specific position parameter

nodes.label: Check Stack Bounds
nodes.description: Validate that item_number < len(evm.stack) before accessing

nodes.label: Bounds Check Passed
nodes.description: Stack has sufficient depth for the requested operation

nodes.label: Bounds Check Failed
nodes.description: Stack depth insufficient, security violation prevented

nodes.label: Raise StackUnderflowError
nodes.description: Halt execution with StackUnderflowError exception

nodes.label: Execution Halted - Stack Underflow
nodes.description: EVM execution stopped due to stack underflow, state reverted

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state the maximum stack depth limit (1024 elements per EIP-1024) that triggers StackOverflowError for PUSH/DUP operations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM stack limit of 1024 elements applies. PUSH and DUP operations that would exceed this limit should raise StackOverflowError.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between GAS_BASE and GAS_VERY_LOW for different PUSH variants is mentioned but exact numeric values are not specified in this module.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM gas costs: GAS_BASE = 2, GAS_VERY_LOW = 3. This follows Yellow Paper conventions.

implicit_assumptions.description: The stack is implemented as a contiguous array with O(1) access time for any position from 0 to len-1.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Performance attacks could be possible if stack access has variable time complexity based on depth.

implicit_assumptions.description: Bytecode is immutable during execution, so PUSH reading from bytecode offset cannot be affected by concurrent modifications.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Race conditions in bytecode reading could allow execution of unintended values.

implicit_assumptions.description: The program counter cannot be manipulated except through explicit control flow operations (JUMP, JUMPI).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Arbitrary PC manipulation could bypass PUSH immediate validation or execute mid-instruction.
